description: Attach a generation (a saved library item) to a campaign's world-graph entity, so its art and details show on that entity. Pass entity_id to link to an existing tracked entity, or omit it and pass entity_type + display_name to create the tracked entity and link in one call (re-using an existing entity with the same name). Re-linking the same generation updates its link metadata.

display_name.description: Name for the created entity (create mode only)

entity_id.description: Existing world-graph entity UUID. Omit to create one from entity_type + display_name

entity_type.description: Type for the created entity (create mode only)

name: chargen_link_generation
title: Link generation to campaign entity
